author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
I just wanted to report 2 players for abusing glitches.
I already told them to relog, cuz they have the survival glitch. The answer was they didn't take care of my words. They were in a team, but not in the tab list, only if you were in the specmode, you could see them. They were also invisible ingame (if you are on a team). 
Screenshot: http://prntscr.com/4uontf 
The blue names are the hint, they were in a team, but still in the spectator mode.
http://avicus.net/thepicklemaster (thepicklemaster)
http://avicus.net/The_Orange_bacca (The_Orange_Bacca)
